thesis: Heliod manufactures a resource nobody at the table prices - cards in your opponents' hands - converts it into a cost discount that lives on their turns, one-sided draw, Treasure and life loss, and spends the turns that buys casting Approach of the Second Sun twice; the second cast is 12 for 12 and everything else is the wait.

stages.label: WHAT PAYS FOR {6}{W} TWICE

evidence.note: 17 of 26 in THE GROUND; the seven rocks Arcane Signet, Azorius Signet, Sol Ring, Talisman of Progress, Thought Vessel, Decanter of Endless Water and Mind Stone in city-2 THE TAP ROOM (its THE ROCKERY hood, all seven); Pearl and Sapphire Medallion in city-0 THE HOME FRONT

deck-facts roles: those seven carry ramp:rock (so does Smothering Tithe, placed in conversion); Pearl and Sapphire Medallion carry ramp:cost-reduction only, and neither has a mana ability. deck-audit's ramp axis counts 12 copies against a 10-12 band and reads AT - the branch's stated constraint for Mind Stone

stages.what_it_does:
32 of the deck's 33 land copies sit here in 17 entries (Mikokoro is placed in ignition), plus seven rocks and two cost-reducers. The bill this stage exists to pay is Approach's, twice: {6}{W} is seven mana on two separate turns. goldfish mean_available_mana_by_turn crosses 7 between turn 7 (6.412) and turn 8 (7.064), and that is with the commander's discount switched OFF: model-coverage gives Heliod only the `bodies` channel.

Measured on the CURRENT list (sha f1d4a650). benchmark missed_land_drop_rate 0.2568, worst turn six; land_drop_hit_rate 0.728 / 0.593 / 0.534 across turns four to six. mana_analysis.json gives 25 W and 26 U total sources against a Karsten 90%-on-curve figure of 36 each - "a yardstick, not a possibility, in a 33-land deck", in that file's own words. Lands-only on-curve 0.610 W / 0.639 U, and 0.580 / 0.610 with Skycloud Expanse set aside as the one gated source. deck-audit reads mana-base (33 against 37-39) and colour-sources UNDER for archetype control, and ramp AT: 12 copies in a 10-12 band, Mind Stone the twelfth.

MIND STONE is here for "{T}: Add {C}", which pays the {3} of the flip exactly as Sol Ring and Thought Vessel do - yet the declared flip component counts those two and not it (proposed_goldfish_edits[2]). Its all-generic {2} is a free flash cast behind two opponent draws; "{1}, {T}, Sacrifice: Draw a card" is the exit once seven mana is on the table. Pearl and Sapphire Medallion reduce the cost of SPELLS rather than produce mana, which is why the map files them away from the rocks and why they cannot pay any part of the flip (map_disagreements[2]). In the v1.2.1 Forge run heliod played a mean 8.42 lands, and Adarkar Wastes was the deck's largest source of damage to ITSELF - 83 of the 128 points in stages[4].

stages.label: THE GIFT - THE TABLE STARTS DRAWING

evidence.note: 6 of 11 in THE GIFT ECONOMY (Howling Mine, Font of Mythos, Kami, Dictate, The Second Doctor, Horn of Greed); Temple Bell, Kwain and Loran in city-2 THE TAP ROOM's THE HAND CRANK hood; Mikokoro in city-1 THE GROUND; Enlightened Tutor in city-0 THE HOME FRONT's THE SEARCH PARTY hood

deck-facts roles: Temple Bell, Faerie Mastermind, Prosperity, Skyscribing and Scrawling Crawler are the only draw:wheel cards; Horn of Greed carries draw:engine; and the taxonomy has no pattern at all for Howling Mine, Font of Mythos or Dictate of Kruphix - deck-facts lists 12 roleless entries. The gift is invisible to roles.

stages.what_it_does:
The first thing that has to happen. NINE of the ten permanents here hand the WHOLE table cards - Howling Mine, Font of Mythos, Kami of the Crescent Moon, Dictate of Kruphix, Temple Bell, Mikokoro, Kwain and The Second Doctor say "each player", and Horn of Greed's "Whenever a player plays a land, that player draws a card" fires for whoever drops the land. Loran of the Third Path alone is "you and TARGET OPPONENT each draw a card". Nothing later fires until one of these resolves. Enlightened Tutor draws nobody; it finds five of the ten (Howling Mine, Font, Temple Bell, Horn, Dictate: artifact or enchantment) and cannot find Approach.

WHERE THE DISCOUNT LIVES. Howling Mine, Font, Kami and Dictate fire in each player's DRAW STEP and Horn on each player's LAND DROP: on an opponent's turn they bank one to three draws before that opponent's main phase ends, and on yours they contribute {0}. Under the back face's flash that is where this deck casts. Only five pieces feed the discount on your own turn: Temple Bell, Mikokoro, Kwain and Loran on activation, The Second Doctor at your end step.

FORGE RAN THE GIFT (v1.2.1 list). Heliod-controlled trigger lines: Dictate 577, Howling Mine 300, Font 184, Kami 125, The Second Doctor 84. Activations: Temple Bell 64, Kwain 46, Mikokoro 26. Loran: cast in 32 of 120 games, its draw ability in no activation line (open_questions[6]). Horn was not in that list.

The rate is the declared component's. "Table draw engine online" assembles in 0.921 of goldfish games (0.971 assisted), 0.822 by turn six, mean turn 2.499 - of the eleven declared targets the highest assembled_rate (next 0.839) and the lowest mean turn (next 2.854). Its eleven members are these ten plus Scrawling Crawler, minus Enlightened Tutor (repaired 2026-09-16 to name Horn).

stages.label: YOUR OWN CARD FLOW, AND THE ONLY ROUTE BACK

evidence.note: 6 of 10 in THE GIFT ECONOMY (Alhammarret's Archive, Teferi's Ageless Insight, Stroke of Genius, Prosperity, Skyscribing, Mathemagics); the other 4 - Dig Through Time, Braingeyser, Mystical Tutor, Long-Term Plans - are in city-0 THE HOME FRONT
deck-facts roles: only Drift of Phantasms and Long-Term Plans carry tutor:unrestricted, and Drift cannot reach Approach at mana value 7

stages.what_it_does:
What keeps the deck running once the table is drawing: eight cards that turn mana into cards for you, plus the two tutors that can actually find the win.

Alhammarret's Archive and Teferi's Ageless Insight each read "if you would draw a card except the first one you draw in each of YOUR draw steps, draw two cards instead" - `your` is the load-bearing word in a deck whose gift fires in every player's draw step. Both are live in Forge (v1.2.1 run): that replacement effect fired 349 times, the Archive cast in 32 games, the Insight in 17. The declared component "Heliod down with an asymmetric card engine" (0.787 assembled, 0.583 by turn six) groups them with Rhystic Study and Consecrated Sphinx; they are split out here because they read YOUR draws, a different trigger and a different job. Of the five X-draw spells, TWO - Prosperity and Skyscribing - draw the whole table; Braingeyser, Stroke of Genius and Mathemagics each target one player and feed the same turn's discount only when aimed at an opponent. Dig Through Time delves, so its printed eight overstates what you pay.

ENUMERATED, because the role tag says otherwise: of the 99, only Mystical Tutor (instant or sorcery) and Long-Term Plans (any card, third from the top) can find Approach of the Second Sun. Enlightened Tutor is artifact-or-enchantment. Drift of Phantasms transmutes for mana value 3; Approach is 7. The declared "Win condition access" component is those two plus Approach itself and assembles 0.495 (0.671 with tutors), 0.358 by turn six. Forge found the route: Mystical Tutor was cast in 38 of 120 games. Long-Term Plans does not appear in the run's logs at all, in any line kind. New at v1.3.0: Mystical Tutor is one of the thirteen instants Isochron Scepter can imprint (lines[12], open_questions[7]).

stages.label: THE ASYMMETRY LAYER - SIX CARDS, ONE TRIGGER
cards: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

evidence.note: 4 of 6 in THE GIFT ECONOMY; Heliod in city-0 THE HOME FRONT, Smothering Tithe in city-2 THE TAP ROOM

deck-facts roles: Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora, Consecrated Sphinx, Faerie Mastermind and Smothering Tithe all carry draw:engine, but so do Arcane Denial, Horn of Greed, Psychosis Crawler, Scrawling Crawler and The Second Doctor - the role does not separate a converter from a draw spell

stages.what_it_does:
The engine proper. The gift is symmetric and therefore not card advantage; these six make it one-sided. Consecrated Sphinx draws two on every opponent draw; Faerie Mastermind one on each opponent's second; Smothering Tithe makes a Treasure unless they pay {2}; Rhystic Study and Mystic Remora bill casts, not draws.

RAN on the v1.2.1 list; heliod-controlled trigger lines: Smothering Tithe 998, Mystic Remora 511, Rhystic Study 410, Consecrated Sphinx 326, Faerie Mastermind 77 - 2,322 from five cards.

THE COMMANDER IS TWO CARDS AND ONLY THE BACK ONE DOES THIS STAGE'S JOB. Heliod, the Warped Eclipse is "You may cast spells as though they had flash" and "Spells you cast cost {1} less to cast for each card your opponents have drawn this turn". Read together: the draw-step and land-drop gifts bank their cards on the OPPONENTS' turns, so the discount is largest exactly when flash lets you spend it - a generic-cost artifact is a free cast at an opponent's end step once their draws cover its price: Isochron Scepter and Mind Stone ({2}) behind two, Horn of Greed ({3}) behind three. The flip is a sorcery-speed "{3}{U/P}". He RESOLVED in 68 of 120 games (0.567 [0.477, 0.652]) and TRANSFORMED in 35 (0.292 [0.218, 0.378]). The multiplier was live in 35 games, not 68.

THE FLIP CROSS-TAB DID NOT REPLICATE. On this run the 35 flip games hold 6 wins (0.171) and the 85 no-flip games hold 14 (0.165) - flat; the v1.0.0 run's 0.114 against 0.271 did not hold. What survives both: the wins do not WAIT on the flip - 10 of the 12 Approach wins are no-flip games, and the gift assembles at 0.921, mean turn 2.499. Multiplier, not ignition.

No `fodder` stage: nothing here is converted by being spent. The resource this engine eats is manufactured on the opponents' side of the table.

stages.label: WHAT IT PRODUCES - AND THE METRIC THAT CANNOT SEE IT

evidence.note: 3 of 5 in THE HOME FRONT (Secure the Wastes, Walking Ballista, Hangarback Walker, all in its TOLLS AND X-SPELLS hood); both Crawlers in city-3 THE GIFT ECONOMY
deck-facts roles: Psychosis Crawler and Scrawling Crawler are the only two cards in the 99 carrying wincon:drain

stages.what_it_does:
THE DRAIN IS LIFE LOSS, NOT DAMAGE, AND THAT CHANGES THE VERDICT AN EARLIER MODEL WROTE. Psychosis Crawler is "whenever you draw a card, each opponent loses 1 life"; Scrawling Crawler is "whenever an opponent draws a card, that player loses 1 life". Neither is damage, so `noncombat_damage_dealt_to_players` cannot see either at any value - reading that field as this axis's verdict was that model's largest measurement error.

COUNTED FROM THE v1.2.1 RUN'S LOGS (re-derived for this revision). "Whenever an opponent draws a card, that player loses 1 life" resolved 851 times (giada-angels 378, baylen-tokens 237, abaddon 236) and "whenever you draw a card, each opponent loses 1 life" 14 times, three opponents each. That is 893 life over 120 games: mean 7.44, MEDIAN 0.0, nonzero in 47, max 104. Scrawling Crawler, cast in 46 games, is essentially the whole of it. Read the pair: off in most games, enormous in a few - a spread, not a clock.

WHAT THE DAMAGE FIELD ACTUALLY HOLDS. heliod's `noncombat_damage_dealt_to_players` sums to 148 (mean 1.23, median 0.0, max 10, nonzero in 48). Splitting the logs by target seat: 128 of those points are heliod damaging its OWN seat - Adarkar Wastes 83, Talisman of Progress 43, 2 more - and only 20 reach an opponent, every one of them Walking Ballista. The metric is not split by whether the target is an opponent; quote it only with that clause attached.

The rest. Three X-cards leave a permanent behind: Secure the Wastes, Walking Ballista, Hangarback Walker; Ballista was cast in 52 games and activated 99 times, the most-activated card in the run. Combat: mean 3.28 dealt, MEDIAN 0.5; commander damage reached 21 in ZERO games. The declared two-card component assembles 0.36, 0.249 by turn six.

stages.label: THE 26 CARDS THAT BUY THE TURNS

evidence.note: 10 in THE HOME FRONT, 7 in city-4 NOT TODAY, 6 in city-5 THE CLEANERS, Kefnet in city-3 THE GIFT ECONOMY, An Offer You Can't Refuse and Isochron Scepter in city-2 THE TAP ROOM - five cities for one job

Reading each one's oracle text from cards.csv: 30 carry flying on the body. THE THIRTEEN IMPRINTS, enumerated from cards.json (type line contains Instant, cmc <= 2): An Offer You Can't Refuse, Arcane Denial, Counterspell, Cyclonic Rift, Disenchant, Dovin's Veto, Enlightened Tutor, Karametra's Blessing, Mystical Tutor, Path to Exile, Secure the Wastes, Swan Song, Swords to Plowshares. By stage: ten here (five counters, four removal, Karametra's Blessing), Enlightened Tutor in ignition, Mystical Tutor in fuel, Secure the Wastes in output. Isochron Scepter's own roles are utility:activated and value:etb - no answer class - which is why it is the sixth roleless card in evidence[1]. The count is thirteen in the branch's stated reason as well (branches/artifacts-v1/branch.json), and it survives re-enumeration.

stages.what_it_does:
26 of 85 entries, the largest stage; its job is to survive to a seven-drop cast twice. Five layers.

COUNTERS (8, two free). "Free or cheap interaction held" assembles 0.839, 0.705 by turn six, but interaction_castable is 0.61 at turn six against 0.929 in hand: holding it and paying for it are different problems.

REMOVAL (7), of which only Day of Judgment and Supreme Verdict are sweepers - two against a control target of 5-7, UNDER (notes[4]).

THE FORT (5): Propaganda, Ghostly Prison and Archangel of Tithes tax attackers - 0.496 assembled, 0.357 by turn six, the least reliable defensive component. Drift, Kefnet and Archangel are three of the five-card flier-blocker component (the other two sit in conversion), 0.68, 0.529 by turn six; Kefnet cannot block under seven cards in hand.

INSURANCE (5), Leyline of Anticipation included because it duplicates the flash grant without him - 0.683 assembled, 0.531 by turn six. Forge (v1.2.1 run): no cast line for Guardian of Faith or Teferi's Protection (notes[6]); Lightning Greaves cast in 29 games, activated 41 times.

THE SCEPTER (1), new at v1.3.0. Isochron Scepter imprints "an instant card with mana value 2 or less": thirteen in the 99, enumerated in evidence[3], ten of them in this stage. A counter or removal every turn for {2} without spending a card is protection made repeatable - hence here, not in mana with the other {2} artifacts. Its {2} cast is generic and discounted; its "{2}, {T}" is an activated ability the discount cannot touch. Not in the run's list, no Forge line.

THE AIR. heliod was eliminated in 74 of 120 games, 61 attributed to damage; of those, giada-angels 43, abaddon 11, baylen-tokens 7. Combat damage taken mean 37.92, median 30.5. The premise holds (evidence[2]); who kills us did not change.

stages.label: ONE CARD, AND IT IS 12 FOR 12

Approach sits in THE GIFT ECONOMY's THE BILL COMES DUE hood with the drain, not with the tutors that find it (THE HOME FRONT's THE SEARCH PARTY)

evidence.id: Approach of the Second Sun + Mystical Tutor
evidence.note: the single contained Commander Spellbook line, bracket 3, mana_value_needed 15, produces 'Win the game'; it is a candidate, and stack 002 is what makes this one a fact

Approach carries the deck's only wincon:alt role (deck-facts histogram: wincon:alt 1). The single_point_of_failure field is AUTHORED and machine-read, so its qualifier belongs beside it: of heliod's 20 wins on the v1.2.1 run, 12 read won_by "effect of 'Approach of the Second Sun'" and 8 read "all opponents have lost", so the deck closes without this card in 8 of 20. deck_audit's own engine.single_points_of_failure is [], because every declared component holds two or more members; this model asserts one anyway because the wincon stage genuinely holds one card - the only other win-flavoured roles in the 99 are the two wincon:drain Crawlers, which stages[4] measures at a median of 0.0 life a game. Read the field as "the only card that WINS", not "the only way the game ends".

stages.what_it_does:
Approach of the Second Sun, cast twice from hand. The first cast gains 7 life and puts the card seventh from the top; the second wins outright.

THE BEST-EVIDENCED SENTENCE IN THIS MODEL, re-derived for this revision from the v1.2.1 run (b0f44e4a, three cards behind this list; none of the three has a line in it). Counting `Add To Stack: ... cast Approach of the Second Sun` across the logs: 39 casts in 27 of 120 games, and exactly 12 games reached a SECOND cast. Cross-tabbed against the record's `games[]`, those 12 are exactly the 12 marked won_by "effect of 'Approach of the Second Sun'" - twelve for twelve. The other 15 games got one cast and none won on it. The deck's whole difficulty sits between the first cast and the second, not in the card resolving.

THE COLUMN. 20 wins, 12 by Approach and 8 by "all opponents have lost": win rate 0.202, ci95 [0.135, 0.292] over the 99 decided games; 20 clocked out and one was a draw. Against par (0.25) the difference is -0.048 and against this table's measured null of 0.181 it is +0.021; the Wilson bounds shifted by each reference ([-0.115, +0.042] and [-0.046, +0.111], notes[0]) both SPAN ZERO. Mean finishing position 2.628 over 94 ranked games (11 firsts, 35 seconds, 26 thirds, 22 fourths).

AND NOT THAT THE DECK GOT WORSE. v1.0.0 scored 27/107 (0.252), v1.2.1 20/99 (0.202), and the Newcombe interval on the DIFFERENCE is [-0.1626, +0.0650], spanning zero; this pair of runs could only detect 0.185 at 80% power (notes[0]). v1.3.0 has no Forge run yet.

This is a ONE-finisher deck; the pilot's standing constraint against two-card infinites rules out the usual second route - deck-facts reads two_card_infinites 0 and bracket_report's list is empty. Stack 002 settles the skill and is quoted in evidence[0].

lines.note: THE TRAP WORTH NAMING. Mikokoro's "{2}, {T}: Each player draws a card" fires on YOUR turn, so three opponents drawing one apiece is {3} off the next spell you cast that turn under "cost {1} less for each card your opponents have drawn THIS TURN". Howling Mine, Font of Mythos, Kami of the Crescent Moon and Dictate of Kruphix cannot do this: they fire "at the beginning of each player's draw step", and an opponent's draw step falls on that opponent's own turn, so on your turn they contribute {0}; Horn of Greed is the same shape on the land drop. FIVE gift pieces in the ignition stage feed the discount on your own turn: Temple Bell, Mikokoro, Kwain and Loran on activation, and THE SECOND DOCTOR at your own end step ("At the beginning of your end step, each player MAY draw a card"). Two of the five are optional on the opponent's side - Kwain and The Second Doctor both say "may". Three more sit outside the stage: Scrawling Crawler at your upkeep (output), Faerie Mastermind's "{3}{U}: Each player draws a card" (conversion) and Skyscribing's forecast (fuel). Gated on the BACK face, which appeared in 0.292 of the v1.2.1 run's games, and not modelled by the goldfish - model-coverage gives Heliod only the bodies channel - so every mana figure in this artifact is a floor. Claim, not fact.

via: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
lines.note: THE OTHER DIRECTION, and the reason Horn of Greed is a gift piece rather than a draw spell. "Whenever a player plays a land, that player draws a card": on each opponent's turn their land drop draws THEM a card, which is {1} off whatever you flash in on that turn under the back face; on your own turn it draws you one. It is the only gift keyed to a land drop rather than a draw step or an activation, so it fires in the opponent's main phase - after Howling Mine's draw-step card has already been banked. Not in the v1.2.1 Forge run's list, so no Forge line; counted in both gift groups of the repaired goldfish declaration. Claim, not fact.

Font of Mythos is "at the beginning of each player's draw step, that player draws TWO ADDITIONAL cards", so it ADDS six opponent draws a round cycle - twelve extra cards for you through Consecrated Sphinx, which draws two on every opponent draw. Measured on the v1.2.1 run, and small: Psychosis Crawler's "whenever you draw a card, each opponent loses 1 life" resolved 14 times in 120 games, 42 life in total against Scrawling Crawler's 851. Claim, not fact.

Scrawling Crawler triggers on OPPONENT draws, which is the other half of the pair and the half Howling Mine feeds. The declared component is "Table draw engine plus a draw-triggered drain, both drawn" - goldfish_targets' label, verbatim. It prices ANY of ten gift pieces (Horn of Greed now among them) plus EITHER Crawler, not this specific pair, at 0.32 assembled and 0.189 by turn six, the deck's least reliable declared pairing. map_disagreements.why: The single most valuable disagreement in this deck. Six cards read the SAME input - an opponent drew a card, or cast a spell - and each states a different OUTPUT, so the map, which is built from card text, files them by what they produce. Smothering Tithe reads as a tap-room card because it says Treasure. Heliod reads as your own board because his type line is a creature. Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora, Consecrated Sphinx and Faerie Mastermind read as the gift economy. No card in the group says what the group is for, so this layer is invisible in card text and cannot be seen by a reader looking at the constellation. The v1.2.1 run makes the case for grouping them: 2,322 trigger lines off one shared event.

26 cards across five cities - the map splits them by HOW they answer (counter text, destroy text, a body, a Treasure rider on An Offer You Can't Refuse) while the deck uses all of them for one job: buy turns until you can cast a seven-drop twice. Kefnet the Mindful lands in THE GIFT ECONOMY because his activated ability draws, which is the least important thing he does here. New at v1.3.0: Isochron Scepter lands in THE TAP ROOM's THE HAND CRANK hood beside Temple Bell and Kwain - the map read "{2}, {T}:" as a handle to crank, which is true of the card's shape and says nothing about the thirteen instants it cranks out.

Pearl Medallion and Sapphire Medallion are cost reduction, not production, so the map puts them in THE HOME FRONT's KEEP THE GOD UP hood with the insurance rather than with the rocks. In this deck they do the rocks' job - shave the bill on a colour-heavy curve. goldfish_targets does NOT count them, in any of its eleven targets' need groups (`grep -c Medallion data/decks/heliod/goldfish_targets.json` returns 0): they were in "Heliod plus the mana to flip him" until c879dcd removed them, because a spell-cost reducer cannot pay any part of "{3}{U/P}: Transform Heliod", an activated ability, and neither card taps for mana. The any_of holds six members and the live figures are 0.741 assembled, 0.561 by turn six, mean turn 4.87. Mind Stone, new at v1.3.0, sits in THE ROCKERY with the other six rocks and is the one rock the any_of omits (proposed_goldfish_edits[2]).

Six of eleven sit in THE GIFT ECONOMY: the four draw-step triggers, The Second Doctor and Horn of Greed. The map split the rest by MECHANISM rather than by what the draw is for - Temple Bell, Kwain and Loran are "{T}:" handles and sit in THE TAP ROOM's THE HAND CRANK hood beside the Treasure makers, one hood over from THE ROCKERY's seven rocks; Mikokoro is a land; Enlightened Tutor is a search and sits with the tutors regardless of what it fetches in this 99. The tap-room three are three of the FIVE own-turn gift pieces lines[0] counts; the other two, Mikokoro (THE GROUND) and The Second Doctor (THE GIFT ECONOMY), sit elsewhere, so the map's 3-against-8 split is near lines[0]'s 5-against-6 without being it.

No disagreement, but the address is worth naming: Approach sits in THE GIFT ECONOMY's THE BILL COMES DUE hood with the two Crawlers, Rhystic Study and Mystic Remora - the map read it on 'gain 7 life' and 'seventh from the top' - while Mystical Tutor and Long-Term Plans, the only two cards that find it, sit in THE HOME FRONT's THE SEARCH PARTY hood. The deck's win and its route to the win have different addresses.

open_questions.question: Does Heliod, the Warped Eclipse's cost reduction let you choose a larger X on Braingeyser, Stroke of Genius, Prosperity, Skyscribing, Mathemagics, Secure the Wastes, Walking Ballista or Hangarback Walker - and if so, is X chosen before or after the reduction applies?
open_questions.why_it_matters: The declared component 'An X-spell finisher drawn (the mana sink the discount pays for)' assembles 0.792 and its whole justification is this interaction. Nothing on disk tests it, and the conversion -> fuel line in this artifact is a claim resting on it.

open_questions.question: While Lightning Greaves is equipped to Heliod, can you still target him with Karametra's Blessing or Guardian of Faith's enters trigger, and is moving the Greaves off in response possible at instant speed?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Greaves grants shroud, which stops your own targeting; equip is sorcery-speed. Greaves is the ONE insurance card the v1.2.1 run actually used (29 games cast, 41 activations) while Guardian of Faith and Teferi's Protection have no cast line at all, so if two of the five slots are mutually exclusive with a third while equipped, the 0.683 assembly figure overstates what the pilot can do in a removal window.

open_questions.question: Can the second Approach of the Second Sun be cast at an opponent's end step under Heliod's flash grant or Leyline of Anticipation, and is Fierce Guardianship's alternative cost live in that window when Heliod himself is the commander on the battlefield?
open_questions.why_it_matters: 12 of 120 games reached a second Approach cast and every one of them won. Anything that widens the window for that cast is the highest-leverage rules question this deck has. Stack 002 resolves only the sorcery-speed cast on your own turn; the end-step cast needs either Leyline of Anticipation or Heliod's BACK face, which appeared in 0.292 of games.

open_questions.question: No declared target measures the deck's actual win: Approach in hand AND seven mana available on two separate turns. Can the harness express a mana condition, or must the gap be recorded rather than modelled?
open_questions.why_it_matters: 'Win condition access' is a three-card any_of (Approach, Mystical Tutor, Long-Term Plans) and assembles 0.495, 0.671 with tutors, 0.358 by turn six - it measures DRAWING one of three cards. Forge says the binding constraint is elsewhere: Approach was cast at all in 27 of 120 games but twice in only 12, and mean_available_mana crosses 7 only between turn 7 and turn 8 on the current list.

open_questions.question: How many tutor and protection slots is a single 'you win the game' card worth in a four-player pod, and how should the one-window cast be timed against three potential responders?
open_questions.why_it_matters: strategic_frame.json (v1.3.0, 8e5d63af) gaps[2] opens "NO SECTION ON ALTERNATE WIN CONDITIONS" and names strategy:multiplayer.pivot-window as the nearest section, "written for board-based kills ('Prefer win attempts that leave a rebuilt position if they fail'), which Approach cannot do"; it states no retrieval score for that query, and the 0.407 an earlier revision quoted came from a frame that no longer exists on disk. This deck's entire plan therefore has no home in the corpus, and the wincon stage has one card where threat-density asks for three to five.

open_questions.question: Can the goldfish measure the card side of this deck - Rhystic Study, Mystic Remora, Consecrated Sphinx, Faerie Mastermind, Psychosis Crawler, Kwain and Loran are all in `draw_not_modelled` - so that a claim about whether mana or cards binds this deck has both arms measured?
open_questions.why_it_matters: meta.card_advantage now reports 14 cards that draw against 6 modelled, with eight named in draw_not_modelled (Irrigated Farmland among them). Forge says the unmodelled half is where the deck lives: 2,322 conversion triggers and 851 drain resolutions over 120 games of the v1.2.1 run, none of it visible to the goldfish. Until that channel is modelled, the mana stage can only say mana is a MEASURED constraint, not that it is the binding one.

open_questions.question: Should the gift and fort components be scored on a card being ON THE BATTLEFIELD, or on it having been USED? Loran of the Third Path was cast in 32 of 120 Forge games and its draw ability was activated zero times; Temple Bell was cast in 22 and activated 64 times.
open_questions.why_it_matters: 'Table draw engine online' assembles 0.921 and is the figure every other stage leans on, but it prices DRAWING one of eleven cards. Two of the eleven (Mikokoro, Temple Bell) and two more (Kwain, Loran) need an activation the deck must have spare mana for, and the repo's own Ashnod's Altar precedent is that a Forge AI may simply never use an outlet with no board payoff. If the assembled rate is really an upper bound, it is an upper bound on the deck's single most-cited number.

open_questions.question: With Mystical Tutor imprinted on Isochron Scepter, does the copy cast at an opponent's end step put Approach of the Second Sun on top of the library so that drawing and casting it next turn satisfies Approach's "cast from your hand" clause for the win - and does a copy of Secure the Wastes cast without paying its mana cost have X = 0?
open_questions.why_it_matters: lines[12] is the one new line in this revision and it would turn the deck's thinnest declared component ('Win condition access', 0.495) into a repeatable route for {2} a turn. Two of the thirteen imprints (Secure the Wastes, and Enlightened Tutor for a different reason) may be worth nothing on the Scepter, and the pilot should know which before choosing what to exile.

proposed_goldfish_edits.change: Add Scrawling Crawler to the FIRST any_of (the ten-card gift group). It is already in the first any_of of "Table draw engine online" and in the second any_of of this target, so the same file calls it a table draw engine in one target and not in the other.

This target is the deck's lowest at 0.32 assembled and 0.189 by turn six, and lines[5] rests on it - and Forge says this card carried the whole drain axis (851 of 865 resolutions), so the direction of the error matters before the figure is read as a weakness.
